name: Tencent Holdings Limited
blurb: Tencent Holdings Limited is an investment holding company that provides value-added services, marketing services, fintech, and business services in Mainland China and internationally. Its consumer business includes communications and social services (instant messaging and social networks), digital content (online games, videos, live streaming, news, music, and literature), fintech services (mobile payment, wealth management, consumer loans, and securities trading), and various tools. Tencent is one of the world's largest internet and technology companies by revenue and market capitalization, with a dominant position in China's social media and gaming markets.
recent: In the past 30 days, Tencent's stock price has shown volatility, trading in a range of approximately 460 to 480 HKD. The company is scheduled to report earnings on May 13, 2026, with analysts expecting continued revenue growth driven by its fintech and gaming segments. Recent news highlights include regulatory developments in China's tech sector and Tencent's ongoing investments in AI and cloud computing.
